coverage_limits: Maintainer attestation boundary: Evidence constitutes a maintainer attestation bound to local CLI execution metadata and git tree/blob hashes, not cryptographic reviewer authentication or hosted service proof.

PR execution context boundary: Because the validator and workflow execute within the pull_request branch context, the PR-controlled checker cannot unilaterally prevent malicious author tampering; existing branch protection, security/build workflows, and maintainer reviews remain necessary trust gates.

Scope and snapshot binding: The review exclusively covers snapshot head 2920016fc58bc03cec441ab5d56105655691426a (tree ebac5e5c8e3da24d6fdf0670d24c1e34eb2896ef) against baseline 1f0050bfba01aa922cb1f55905c78a698b126fbe. Only .github/review-evidence/windows-fixes.json may be added subsequently; any other file modification, deletion, or mode change invalidates the attestation and requires a fresh review.
PR baseline coupling: Baseline must strictly equal the pull request base commit (EXPECTED_REVIEW_BASE); any base drift or rebase requires re-validation.
CI and offline validation: CI validation runs purely offline synthetic tests and verification scripts without hosted model invocation, credential provisioning, or network AI access.

review_scope: Workflow, validator, policy and evidence design at snapshot; unchanged Windows source fixes covered by separate source_review below.

coverage_limits: Native Windows environments lacking SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege (Developer Mode disabled) cannot execute file symlink creation tests (e.g. __tests__/security-mcp.test.ts), which are conditionally skipped via context.skip as intended platform coverage gaps.
Native Windows lacks POSIX directory file descriptors (dir_fd / openat), precluding race-free directory-relative file descriptor operations available on POSIX systems.
The 13 skipped tests in the full bounded run and 8 skipped tests in the hub run reflect these platform-constrained coverage boundaries rather than regressions.

trust_limit: Maintainer-recorded attestation; not independently authenticated AI output. PR-controlled validator cannot prevent malicious fabrication.
evidence_only_followup: Only this JSON is added after the reviewed snapshot; it was not represented as part of the old source-only review.
